name: Create visual artwork with text-based descriptions
description: Users asked the AI to create visual artworks, such as drawings, paintings, ASCII art, or concept designs, using text or simple character-based formats. The requests covered a wide range of subjects, from specific characters and landscapes to educational diagrams, with some users seeking technical instructions or artistic guidance to achieve these results manually.
